_description: The pipeline contract as data (v4.0). Nodes are phases; reads/writes are the file-based handoff contract; loop_target is the budgeted gate-fail back-edge. This file is AUTHORITATIVE for the pipeline's shape: the SKILL.md contract table narrates it, checkpoint-manager.py and run-audit.py must agree with it (guarded by tests/test_pipeline_graph.py), and the portable execution lane walks it in order. Tokens: 'brand_profile' = the brand's brand-profile.json; 'requirements' = the original-requirements block; 'config:*' = a file under config/. Writes marked optional:true exist only under their stated condition.

0.5.label: Title Curation
0.5.gate: User-confirmed title (or --title bypass) — a user checkpoint, not a numbered quality gate

1.label: Research

writes.note: v4.0 companion: the verified Internal-Link Inventory as data rows, so the orchestrator can merge it into brand_pages via harvest-brand-pages.py --merge-inventory instead of handing the owner a to-do

1.gate: Gate 1: 12-15 sources; >=10 citable; >=5 reliability >=8; differentiated angle; Client Site Reconnaissance; >=3 verified deep brand URLs when the brand has a website

2.label: Fact Check
2.gate: Gate 2: >=80% claims verified; zero UNRESOLVED flags; <=3 unverified; all cited URLs live

3.label: Content Draft
3.gate: Gate 3: body_word_count within +/-10% of target (stated counting convention); all outline sections; >=1 citation per 300 words

3.5.label: Visual Assets

writes.note: contains the ANNOTATED draft — the operative article text from this phase onward; placeholders replaced with VISUAL anchors

3.5.gate: Gate 3.5: every chart traceable to a verified statistic; manifest complete; human-action TODOs marked; placeholder replacement verified by the phase itself

4.label: Scientific Validation

writes.note: the fix ledger — required whenever the report names a correction; empty items is valid

4.gate: Gate 4: zero hallucinations; every claim ledger-traceable; fix-ledger validate --target exits 0; every named correction is in the ledger

5.label: Structure & Proofread
5.gate: Gate 5: fix-ledger verify zero unresolved blocking (HARD); zero grammar/spelling on re-scan; readability within tolerance; brand terminology; VISUAL anchors preserved

6.label: SEO / GEO
6.gate: Gate 6: keyword placements (title, first-100, >=2 H2s, conclusion, meta); all internal-link URLs live (HARD); >=2 deep brand links when site known

6.5.label: Humanizer

writes.note: article body ONLY — authorship measures this file
v4.0 companion: {pattern_id: count} for every catalog pattern that fired, so telemetry.py can aggregate recurrence across runs — the report stays for humans, this file is for the loop

6.5.gate: Gate 6.5: grounding pass; 43-pattern catalog; GEO structure preserved; keywords preserved; tell-scan reported (advisory); authorship exit 0 when author draft (HARD); fix-ledger verify not exit 3 (HARD)

7.label: Reviewer

writes.note: written by fix-ledger.py verify --out, copied never re-derived

7.gate: Gate 7: decision per config/scoring-thresholds.json; approve >=7.0 industry-adjusted; dimension minimums; dead internal link = hard FAIL; fix_ledger copied from script output

8.label: Output Manager
8.gate: Gate 8: .docx by script with appendices A-D; no scaffolding; every generated asset anchored; only approved assets embedded; fix-ledger verify sets publication_status via --data; DRAFT- prefix on both copies when blocked

post_pipeline_lifecycle._comment: The between-skills loop (v4.0). Not phases — durable per-brand stores with named producers and consumers, so the lifecycle survives sessions.
